text_block_list.name: Chika
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm sorry. I was just... captiva— Errr, moved
by how many you've managed to defeat.
You truly are incredible, {0}.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
いえ……
その、
ちょっと見惚れ……
感動していまして。
こんなに沢山の数を倒すなんて、
やはり{0}さんは凄いです。

text_block_list.name: Chika
text_block_list.text:
I tried not to show it, but having Foggy turn against me and strip
me of my memories was terrifying. I didn't know what to do.
But with you by my side, I can handle anything. So let us continue on!
text_block_list.orig_text:
大精霊が敵になり、
記憶を奪われ、
本当はとても
心細かったのですが、
{0}さんと一緒なら……
さあ、
次も気を緩めずにいきましょう！
